reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
)
SELECT channel_id, spend_date, spend_eur,
  SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_spend_eur
FROM daily

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.channel_id, d.spend_date, d.spend_eur,
  (SELECT SUM(d2.spend_eur) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.channel_id = d.channel_id AND d2.spend_date <= d.spend_date) AS cumulative_spend_eur
FROM daily d

WITH daily AS (
  -- one row per channel and day with spend
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.spend_date, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.spend_date
)
SELECT d.channel_id, d.spend_date, d.spend_eur, SUM(e.spend_eur) AS cumulative_spend_eur
FROM daily d
JOIN daily e ON e.channel_id = d.channel_id AND e.spend_date <= d.spend_date
GROUP BY d.channel_id, d.spend_date, d.spend_eur
